当你的应用需要播放DRM加密保护的音视频内容时使用DRM Kit
典型场景包括在线视频平台的付费内容播放、数字版权保护的直播流播放、企业内部加密媒体内容的分发与播放等
DRM Kit负责处理证书下载、许可证获取和内容解密等版权保护相关流程
当你是DRM解决方案集成方，需要将特定DRM方案集成到系统中时使用DRM插件管理能力
当你的应用需要安全视频通路实现端到端的内容保护时，DRM Kit提供安全解密接口以实现内容在安全通路中的解密和渲染
实现加密视频的授权后播放 / Implement licensed playback for encrypted video
接入 Widevine 或其他 DRM 方案保护流媒体内容 / Integrate Widevine or another DRM solution to protect streaming media
管理 MediaKeySession 与离线许可证的申请、恢复和释放 / Manage MediaKeySession and offline license acquire, restore, and release
处理 DRM 证书 provision 请求并完成设备注册 / Handle DRM provisioning requests and complete device registration
在 AVPlayer 中播放受版权保护的 HLS 或 DASH 内容 / Play copyright-protected HLS or DASH content in AVPlayer
用 AVCodec 解码带 DRM 保护的音视频流 / Decode DRM-protected audio and video streams with AVCodec
监听许可证过期并自动续期播放授权 / Listen for license expiration and auto-renew playback rights
获取媒体内容的 keyId 并创建解密会话 / Get the media keyId and create a decryption session
为付费课程或会员影片添加防盗播播放控制 / Add anti-piracy playback control for paid courses or premium videos
实现离线下载内容的 DRM 授权校验 / Implement DRM authorization checks for offline downloaded content
集成自定义 DRM 插件完成密钥交换和解密 / Integrate a custom DRM plugin for key exchange and decryption
在播放前向许可证服务器发送 challenge 并导入响应 / Send a challenge to the license server before playback and import the response
do_not_use_when: 需求是图片解码、编码、编辑、EXIF元数据处理、HDR转换或AI超分辨率增强，应改用 image-kit / The task is image decoding, encoding, editing, EXIF metadata handling, HDR conversion, or AI super-resolution enhancement; use image-kit instead
preconditions: 目标设备或系统已集成并启用对应的DRM解决方案/插件能力 / The target device or system has integrated and enabled the required DRM solution/plugin capability
应用可访问DRM证书和许可证服务器，相关网络链路与服务端配置可用 / The app can reach the DRM provisioning and license servers, and the network path and server configuration are available
待播放媒体确认为受支持的DRM内容，协议/封装/编解码与所选方案兼容 / The media to be played is confirmed to be supported DRM content, and its protocol/container/codecs are compatible with the chosen solution
inputs: DRM系统标识或UUID / DRM system identifier or UUID
媒体内容信息（如HLS或DASH地址） / Media content information such as HLS or DASH URL
证书申请数据或Provision请求参数 / Certificate provisioning data or provision request parameters
许可证请求参数或服务器返回的许可证数据 / License request parameters or license data returned by the server
媒体初始化数据或会话相关的DRM初始化信息 / Media initialization data or session-related DRM init information

postconditions.statement: 已创建并初始化DRM会话，应用代码包含MediaKeySystem或MediaKeySession相关调用 / A DRM session is created and initialized, and the app code includes MediaKeySystem or MediaKeySession related calls
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set show code that creates or initializes a DRM MediaKeySystem and/or MediaKeySession for protected playback?

postconditions.statement: 已接入证书申请或许可证申请/设置流程，代码体现与DRM服务端的数据交互或许可证绑定步骤 / A provisioning or license request/set flow is wired in, and the code reflects interaction with the DRM server or license binding steps
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set add a DRM provisioning or license acquisition/set flow, including handling request/response data for the DRM session?

postconditions.statement: DRM能力已与播放器或解码流程关联，用于受保护内容播放或解密 / DRM capability is connected to the player or decode pipeline for protected content playback or decryption
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set connect the DRM session/keys to a playback or decoding path such as AVPlayer or AVCodec for protected media?
